# proxmox_sdn_route_map_entry (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN route map entry from `/cluster/sdn/route-maps/entries/{route_map_id}/{order}`. Entries stay Proxmox property strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_route_map_entry" "inbound" {
  route_map_id = "inbound"
  order        = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `order` (Number) Order of the entry inside the route map.
- `route_map_id` (String) Route map that owns the entry.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String)
- `call` (String)
- `exit_action` (String)
- `id` (String) Entry identifier (`<route_map_id>/<order>`).
- `match` (List of String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `set` (List of String)
- `state` (String)
